description: This file provides an API for interacting with the RTL8367C switch hardware, specifically for PHY (Physical Layer) register access and Serdes register configuration. It contains functions to read/write PHY registers via OCP (Open Core Protocol), manage PHY and Serdes registers, and includes conditional compilation for different access modes.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 ocpData)
methods.description: Sets PHY OCP registers using different access methods based on compile-time configuration.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Gets PHY OCP registers with conditional handling for busy status.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 phyData)
methods.description: Write PHY register via OCP address calculation.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Read PHY register via OCP address calculation.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 value)
methods.description: Configure Serdes registers for specified sdsId, sdsReg, and sdsPage.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 * value)
methods.description: Read Serdes register with busy wait handling.
